author: bardic-inspiration
name: Stalwart Breastplate
summary: A breastplate that steadies you against being shoved.
description: The plate is thick and plain, and a hundred dents have been pounded out of it. Shield bearers love it.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. You have Advantage on saving throws against effects that would move you against your will or give you the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
